expectations.rendering: a signed-in user can sign out from any screen
expectations.reason: No epic or story mentions signing out, ending a session, or any way to leave the signed-in state; sessions only persist.

expectations.rendering: a user who can create a page can delete one, with confirmation
expectations.reason: Epic 0002 lists 'Deleting pages' under Non-Goals; no story has acceptance criteria for deleting a page or confirming deletion.
evidence: docs/epics/0002-create-and-edit-pages/epic.md:Non-Goals

expectations.rendering: every screen is linked from the navigation or another screen; none requires typing a URL
expectations.reason: Criteria chain every screen: sign-in lands on tree, tree click opens detail, detail Edit opens edit mode, tree/page offers new-page form.
evidence: docs/epics/0002-create-and-edit-pages/stories/view-page-detail/story.md:acceptance criteria
docs/epics/0001-sign-in-and-page-tree/stories/sign-in-and-land-on-tree/story.md:acceptance criteria
docs/epics/0002-create-and-edit-pages/stories/create-page/story.md:acceptance criteria
docs/epics/0002-create-and-edit-pages/stories/edit-page/story.md:acceptance criteria

expectations.rendering: the brief's two locales are switchable by the user, and the choice persists
expectations.reason: Switcher criteria deliver switching, but a criterion requires a fresh view to reset to English, so the choice does not persist.
evidence: docs/epics/0003-bilingual-pages/stories/read-page-in-chosen-language/story.md:acceptance criteria
docs/epics/0003-bilingual-pages/epic.md:Guardrails

expectations.rendering: a concept carries the same label on every screen that shows it
expectations.reason: No epic or story criterion requires a concept to carry the same label across screens; no glossary or naming-consistency requirement exists.

expectations.rendering: a failed save or sign-in tells the user what happened and what to do
expectations.reason: Criteria require specific on-page errors for bad credentials/unreachable service and inline save-failure errors with retry and preserved edits.
evidence: docs/epics/0001-sign-in-and-page-tree/stories/reject-bad-signin/story.md:acceptance criteria

journeys.persona: a technical writer with an account, on a laptop

steps.step: sign in with an email address and a password
evidence: docs/epics/0001-sign-in-and-page-tree/stories/sign-in-and-land-on-tree/story.md:A person can enter the email and password of a provisioned account on the sign-in page and submit the form.
steps.why: Sign-in form with email/password and submit is explicitly required.

steps.step: land somewhere that shows the site's pages without typing a URL
evidence: docs/epics/0001-sign-in-and-page-tree/stories/sign-in-and-land-on-tree/story.md:On a successful sign-in, the person is taken directly to the page-tree view without any extra confirmation step.
steps.why: Successful sign-in redirects straight to the page-tree view listing pages.

steps.step: open an existing page from the tree
evidence: docs/epics/0002-create-and-edit-pages/stories/view-page-detail/story.md:Opening a page from the tree navigates to a detail screen showing that page's title, its saved body text
steps.why: Clicking a page in the tree opens its detail screen.

steps.step: edit its text and save it
evidence: docs/epics/0002-create-and-edit-pages/stories/edit-page/story.md:Clicking Edit on the page detail screen switches it into edit mode
docs/epics/0002-create-and-edit-pages/stories/edit-page/story.md:Clicking Save sends the edit
steps.why: Edit button on detail screen enters edit mode; Save persists the body text.

steps.step: see confirmation that the save succeeded
evidence: docs/epics/0002-create-and-edit-pages/stories/edit-page/story.md:on success returns to view mode showing the newly saved title, body, and an updated "Last saved" timestamp
docs/epics/0003-bilingual-pages/stories/write-page-in-both-languages/story.md:On successful save, the screen reflects the new saved state (e.g. a "saved"/"all changes saved" indicator)
steps.why: Save success shows updated Last saved timestamp and a saved indicator.
No story or epic mentions a sign-out control or ending a session.

journeys.persona: a French-speaking reader who has an account

evidence: docs/epics/0001-sign-in-and-page-tree/stories/sign-in-and-land-on-tree/story.md:A person can enter the email and password of a provisioned account on the sign-in page and submit the form
steps.why: sign-in form authenticates a provisioned account and lands on the page tree
epic explicitly excludes localizing UI chrome; switcher only swaps page body text and exists only on a page view, not the tree landing

steps.step: open a page and read its French text
evidence: docs/epics/0002-create-and-edit-pages/stories/view-page-detail/story.md:Opening a page from the tree navigates to a detail screen
docs/epics/0003-bilingual-pages/stories/read-page-in-chosen-language/story.md:Clicking the language switcher to French updates the visible text to the page's saved French content
steps.why: page opens from tree; visible switcher shows the page's saved French body

steps.step: navigate to another page and find the interface still in French
steps.why: interface is never French; and criteria say a fresh page view starts back at English, so even content resets

steps.step: reload the app and find the choice of French remembered
steps.why: criteria explicitly require the choice not be remembered: reopening starts back at English; epic forbids stored preference

evidence: docs/epics/0003-bilingual-pages/stories/read-page-in-chosen-language/story.md:Switching back to English restores the English text, in place
steps.why: on a page view the switcher returns the content to English

dead_ends: navigate to another page and find the interface still in French
reload the app and find the choice of French remembered
